answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Like a prism that splits light into layers, each attestation is traced back to a bonded identity. Like a lotus rising from still water, a new identity earns standing only through verified work. Its record grows like an orchard, one checked harvest at a time.
